training_spec.checkpoint_selection: exact step100 only; compare original checkpoint on same validation; no best-of-many search

provenance.labels: separate optical-Z npy from actual capture pose; labels never enter H5 depth or model input
provenance.model_input_h5_depth: zeros; validation H5 immutable; verify rendered RGB equality before accepting label
provenance.simulator_pose_use: offline sensor/label rendering and split audit only; never model or tracker input

exclusions.oracle_control_frames_and_outputs: never training or validation supervision sources

split_audit.method: CPU MuJoCo first-visible rays; opticalZ .02..4m; no model/SLAM scores, stepping or GPU rendering
split_audit.scope: sampled visible surface separation, not complete frustum proof; shared room/materials and unsampled thin surfaces remain limitations
split_audit.validation_scope: previously screened coffee capture, now predeclared development validation; not unseen test; highly correlated native frames span3.935s

fresh_test_reservation.heading_control: measured odometry yaw target0; stale/fault stop; no world-truth feedback
fresh_test_reservation.selection: rint(linspace(0,N-1,48)) after fixed24s capture, no score selection
fresh_test_reservation.tracking: same native sequence, frozen central150 frames if depth passes; not decimated48
fresh_test_reservation.prospective_geometry_only: home east partition/floor; body x approximately-.17..+.15,y approximately0; actual pose is not control feedback
fresh_test_reservation.required_preacceptance_audit: compare actual test visible-surface rays against training/validation; report overlap, no tuning or silent score-driven recapture
